packageDirectories.versionDescription: Capacity Queries: admin-defined counts of your own records, built from dropdowns with live validation, used as hard caps and/or load metrics. Floor on a capacity query is a priority band, so whoever is under it is served first until they reach it, which is how you ramp a new joiner. New Least Loaded algorithm ranks on that load divided by member weight. Member Tiers give a primary pool plus an overflow bench that still respects every gate. Simulator shows live capacity readings, load scores, floor status, tiers and config warnings.
